title: Automated classification of dental implant brands and prosthetic platform sizes on panoramic radiographs using deep learning
html: Incomplete clinical records can be a significant hurdle in implant dentistry, transforming routine maintenance or a restorative task into a complex search. When the primary documentation—such as the implant passport or surgical report—is missing, the clinician is forced to rely on radiographic identification and trial-and-error, which increases the risk of component mismatch and patient dissatisfaction.
